create_laplace_distribution: create a Laplace distribution with a given location and scale parameter using distrax
sample_laplace_distribution: sample random values from a Laplace distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob_laplace: compute the log probability of a value under a Laplace distribution
compute_kl_divergence_laplace: compute the KL divergence between two Laplace distributions using the registered TFP function
compute_entropy_laplace: compute the Shannon entropy in nats for a Laplace distribution
